MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outlet extender fits the practical needs of adding more home electronics: extra outlets and USB charging could help me power the devices I already use.",
    "The router connects naturally to my previous Wi-Fi extender and recent Echo purchases because reliable connectivity matters across those devices.",
    "The microSD card fits my earlier memory-card and card-reader purchases, provided my devices support its capacity and format."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The internal SSDs, multi-drive adapter and heatsinks assume a computer upgrade project I have not shown a need for; my external drive and card reader offered convenient storage without opening a computer.",
    "The iPad keyboard case requires a particular tablet I have not shown that I own. My keyboard purchases do not establish that compatibility.",
    "The gaming earbuds do not address a current need suggested by my recent purchases, and another bedside clock feels less useful after my Echo purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My storage purchases seem to have been taken as interest in any storage hardware, even though removable storage and internal computer components involve different needs.",
    "My interest in keyboards and home electronics seems to have been stretched to accessories that require an unestablished device or gaming interest."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Echo devices and stand suggest that useful additions to my existing home setup matter right now, especially power and connectivity.",
    "Compatibility matters before an accessory becomes useful: liking a keyboard or owning storage does not mean I have the specific tablet or internal drive setup it requires.",
    "My replacement remote batteries and practical peripherals suggest that maintaining equipment I already use can be more relevant than starting a new hardware project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my practical electronics needs but stretched that interest too far into internal upgrades and accessories for devices I have not shown I own."
}
